sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B · LLM Releases
sources.snippet: A 27B dense model (~28B counting the ~1B vision encoder) with 64 layers, hidden size 5,120, and a 248,320-token vocabulary. Uses a hybrid attention stack — 48 Gated DeltaNet linear-attention layers to 16 full Gated Attention layers (a 3:1 split) — for a native 262,144-token context, extendable to 1M via YaRN.
